messages:
Maya (PM): Quick decision thread re: canary sampling, cost bands, and throttle UX for console observability. Customers keep asking for both trace visibility AND cost predictability. Need concrete defaults and launch gates today.

Ravi (ENG): TL;DR — backend can handle per-tenant sampling + dynamic retention, but we need sane defaults exposed in Console. Proposing default sample_rate=0.001 (0.1%) and error_preserve_mode=\"retain-all-errors-above-threshold\" (threshold=5 errors/min). Also expose an SLA mode for enterprise where sampling is higher.

Alina (SRE): We need an automated budget guard tied to USD/day. Ops wants three preset bands: dev ($10/day), team ($75/day), enterprise (manual). If projected spend > band, system should: 1) demote full spans to header-only; 2) cut sample_rate by 90%; 3) emit a P1 alert to tenant owner.

Jordan (ML): For launch acceptance, recommend two signals: (A) detection recall — 90% of known error signature classes surface in sampled traces during 48h canary; (B) regression delta — no more than 5% drop in anomaly detection F1 compared to full capture.

Maya (PM): Good. Let's be explicit in Console UX: top-level tenant card shows \"Telemetry budget used\" (USD today), \"Sampling status\" (normal / uplifted / throttled), and a one-click \"Pause high-fidelity traces\" for support. Owners: Ravi for API + console, Alina for budget engine, Jordan for evaluation harness.

Ravi (ENG): Implementation sketch (API + config example):

```
sampling_config = {
  "default_sample_rate": 0.001,
  "error_preserve": {
    "mode": "threshold",
    "threshold_per_minute": 5
  },
  "adaptive_policies": [
    {"when": "error_rate>1%", "set_rate": 0.01, "ttl_sec": 3600},
    {"when": "p99_latency>2s", "set_rate": 0.005, "ttl_sec": 1800}
  ],
  "budget_band_usd": 75
}
```

Ravi (ENG): Console will surface editable presets and allow a custom numeric USD/day. API will accept a budget_band_usd and autoscale decisions will reference it.

Alina (SRE): Circuit-breaker numeric: set hard cap at $150/day per-tenant for GA. When cap hit: mark tenant as throttled, switch to headers-only, annotate events with \"throttled=true\" for downstream processing. Ops runbook: global revert to 0.05% sampling if more than 3 tenants hit throttle in 24h.

Maya (PM): Launch acceptance checklist (draft):
- Sampling API + Console presets implemented (owner: Ravi)
- Budget enforcement + alerts + throttle behavior (owner: Alina)
- Canary plan: 3 tenants covering high-QPS, error-bursty, and long-tail latency (owner: Jordan)
- Acceptance metrics: 90% recall of error classes + F1 regression <= 5% (owner: Jordan)
- Customer docs + billing FAQ (owner: Maya)

Jordan (ML): Canary plan details: recruit one large enterprise with bursty errors, one mid-market with steady load, one internal test account to simulate spike scenarios. Run recall evals after 24h and 48h, produce short report to share at Friday sync.

Ravi (ENG): ETA: core sampling + budget enforcement in 2 sprints; console UI in sprint 3; throttle integration and headers-only fast-path in parallel sprint 2. If ML needs eval infra earlier, we can expose synthetic mode to mirror sampling locally.

Alina (SRE): Ops asks: feature toggle to force global conservative sampling at runtime, and playbook entry to disable adaptive uplifts per-tenant. I'll add those to runbook.

DeployBot: New issue created: github.com/redwood/infer/issues/1981 — \"per-tenant sampling + budget enforcement\" (assigned: @Ravi).

Maya (PM): Sounds good. Next steps: Ravi wires API shape + mock Console card by EOD Wednesday, Alina drafts runbook actions and throttle thresholds, Jordan seeds canary tenants. Friday 11am sync to review canary plan + draft docs. :rocket:
